commands.command: set -e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 91d6fc115956ec1e221e406fc9fca64527e2c916; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo '== source files =='; find app/src privileged-helper/src audio-bridge/src realtime-client/src -type f | grep -E '\.(java|kt|aidl)$' | sort; echo '== synchronized =='; grep -RIn 'synchronized' app/src privileged-helper/src --include='*.java' --include='*.kt' || true; echo '== threads =='; grep -RIn 'new Thread' app/src privileged-helper/src --include='*.java' --include='*.kt' || true; echo '== handlers/loopers =='; grep -RInE 'Handler|Looper' app/src privileged-helper/src --include='*.java' --include='*.kt' || true

set -e; echo '== reference files per type =='; for C in CallAudioCapture CallAudioInjector PcmFrame AudioBridgeMetrics RealtimeTransport ShellAudioProbe CallAssistantAudioProbe DownlinkPipeProbe BidirectionalMediaProbe PcmMetrics ProbeArguments ToneGenerator SamsungCallMediaSessionController SamsungDownlinkPipeSession SamsungUplinkPipeSession SamsungCallAssistantTrack SamsungVoiceDownlinkCapture PrivilegedCallContexts ShizukuCallMediaUserService ShizukuUserServiceProbe ShizukuWatchdogProbe ShizukuAbortLatencyProbe ShizukuEnduranceProbe; do N=$(grep -RIl --exclude-dir=build --include='*.java' --include='*.kt' --include='*.aidl' "$C" app privileged-helper audio-bridge realtime-client | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "$C $N"; done; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
